updates.title: CVE-2026-97785: AAD App Proxy Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A vulnerability in Azure AD Application Proxy allows improper authentication, enabling unauthorized attackers to escalate privileges over a network. Organizations using App Proxy should apply the available security update promptly to prevent unauthorized access to proxied applications.

updates.title: CVE-2026-80092: Microsoft Identity Web Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: Microsoft Identity Web versions 3 and 4 contain an elevation of privilege vulnerability; affected versions require updates to 3.16.0 or 4.16.1 respectively. Any organization using Microsoft Identity Web for authentication should verify they are running the patched versions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management Alert Classification
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now allows authorized analysts to classify alerts as True Positive, Benign (Operational), or False Positive with predefined reasons, replacing the previous dismissal workflow. This enhancement helps tenants better organize and report on risk signals while improving alert-tuning accuracy.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view per-policy coverage reports that show how many files have been labeled or remain unlabeled during enforcement, compared to simulation snapshots. This visibility helps administrators track enforcement progress and identify data that may require attention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Protection Integration with Data Lifecycle Management
updates.summary: Adaptive Protection now integrates with Data Lifecycle Management to automatically apply retention labels based on a user's insider risk level, moving users in and out of preservation policies dynamically. This integration tightens data governance by aligning retention decisions with risk assessment.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Azure PST Import
updates.summary: Organizations can now import PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage directly into Exchange Online mailboxes using a two-step migration pattern with validation and execution phases. This streamlines PST ingestion for mailbox migrations without requiring on-premises infrastructure.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now supports access to Exchange Archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary) through a unified interface, preparing for EWS API deprecation. This enables administrators to manage archive data retention and governance through modern API endpoints.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Communication Compliance - Alert Improvements
updates.summary: Communication Compliance is receiving enhancements to alerting capabilities and customization options for detection rules. These improvements help compliance teams better tailor and manage alerts to organizational communication policies.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP - FTP and SFTP Transfer Protection
updates.summary: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention now supports monitoring and restricting sensitive data transfers over FTP and SFTP protocols with policy-based actions. Organizations can extend DLP enforcement to file transfer protocols that were previously outside policy scope.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network Data Security - Entra Global Secure Access Integration
updates.summary: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access now integrates with Purview to enforce DLP policies and detect risky activity at the network layer, protecting data transmitted through browsers, apps, APIs, and AI platforms. This network-layer enforcement prevents sensitive data leakage to untrusted cloud applications.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Barriers Policy Compliance Report
updates.summary: A new Information Barriers compliance report identifies SharePoint sites, OneDrive accounts, and SharePoint Embedded containers that no longer comply with policies after changes. Admins can now proactively detect and remediate compliance gaps when updating Information Barriers policies.
